beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: I pay one bill before rent. Myself.

beats.speaker: rohan
beats.say: We both earn $4,000 a month. Three checks, and the last one hurts.

beats.speaker: rohan
beats.say: My way: rent, food, fun. Whatever's left at month end, I save. Usually $100.

beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: My way: on payday, 20% moves out first. That's $800, before I can touch it.

beats.speaker: priya
beats.say: Check one, 10 years in, at an assumed 7%. Rohan's pot: $17,409. Sharma's: $139,276.

beats.speaker: rohan
beats.say: My leftovers, invested 30 years at an assumed 7%: $122,709. Not bad!

beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: Mine, at the same assumed rate, over 30 years: $981,670.

beats.speaker: priya
beats.say: Nobody earned more. Only the order changed. Sharma saved before life could spend it. That's $858,961.

beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: The rich don't save what's left. They spend what's left.

beats.speaker: rohan
beats.say: Fine. Next payday, I'm paying me first.
